scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a terracotta robe, blue-green mantle and cream head covering sings with open hands in a sunlit stone courtyard. Nine smiling children approach through an open wooden gateway; a girl in front carries yellow flowers. An olive tree shades the pale walls, with hills and houses beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined tableau personifies the desolate woman addressed by the verse. Her song and the arriving children evoke the LORD's promise of abundant restoration. It does not depict a recorded family event, pregnancy or childbirth, and the pictured children are not a literal count of the promised multitude or its comparison with the married woman. God remains unseen.
